Name: Chainbreaker's Tenacity
Text: Chosen allied unit gets +1 power until end of turn and gains 2 armor.

Name: Tactical Withdrawal
Text: Return up to one chosen allied unit to its owner's hand. Draw a card.

Name: Blindside
Text: Chosen opposing unit gets -3 power until the end of your opponent's turn.

Name: Devilhorn Scouting Party
Text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may deploy a unit card with Requisition cost 3 or less from among them for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, Scratch 1.

Name: Improvised Orders
Text: Draw 3 cards, then discard a card.

Name: Pincer Tactics
Text: Deal 1 damage to each of up to 2 chosen allied units. Deal 2 damage to chosen non-Scratch asset.

Name: Poisoned Rations
Text: Chosen unit gets -3 max health until end of turn.

Name: Reaver's Rush
Text: Deploy chosen unit card with power 3 or less from your discard pile for free.

Name: Allshan's Battle Trance
Text: Deploy chosen unit card from your discard pile to the Main Theater. It gains Stalwart and gets +2 power until end of turn.

Name: Ambush Tactics
Text:
Choose two:
- Kill chosen unit.
- Return chosen unit to its owner's hand.
- Chosen unit deals damage equal to its power to chosen unit.
- Put chosen unit on top of its owner's deck.

Name: Steel Rain
Text:
Discard up to 3 cards. For each card discarded this way, deal 2 damage to chosen asset.
Then, if you have no cards in hand, draw 2 cards.
